In this piece, the stage is conceptualized as a museum, meticulously divided into two distinct sections:
Upper Section: Drawing inspiration from Wassily Kandinsky’s Composition VIII, the dancer embodies the abstract elements of points, lines, and planes, translating these geometric forms into dynamic body movements. The performance harmonizes with digital animation, creating a cohesive stage artwork that reinterprets Composition VIII through a blend of physicality and technology.
Lower Section: Inspired by Ira Elshansky’s animation whiteland, this section portrays a transformative journey from despair to hope—“嗐！这烂泥一样的人生” (Alas! Such a muddy life) to “嗨！这烂泥一样的人生” (Ah! Such a muddy life). The dancer, acting as a living clay sculpture, engages with the white space, exploring the tension between human form and the void.

content: The first outdoor environmental dance performance at Wuhan Conservatory of Music, which explores the intricate relationship between dance, space, and the environment, transforming familiar locations into vibrant art spaces. “Every Space is an Art Space” is our central theme. We believe that art is not confined to traditional venues; it can be found and created anywhere. content:
🔗 YouTube
Got inspired by the allusion: “The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind.”
I am deeply fond of classical Chinese prose, where words are refined and precise, conveying rich and profound meanings with just a few phrases. It exhibits a beauty that is both concise and powerful. I would like to share the original text here:
园中有树，其上有蝉，蝉方奋翼悲鸣，欲饮清露，不知螳螂之在后，曲其颈，欲攫而食之也，而不知黄雀在后欲啄而食之也。《说苑·正谏》
In this piece, the relationships between the three characters mirror the dynamic tension among the mantis, cicada, and oriole. By using personification, the dance portrays their open and covert struggles, with undercurrents of tension flowing throughout. The music, which integrates the sounds of insects and birds, further enhances this atmosphere, and as the conflicts escalate, faster drum beats are introduced to heighten the sense of urgency and confrontation. Complementing the music, the stage lighting frequently employs contrasts between warm and cool tones, effectively symbolizing the ongoing battle and opposition between the characters.

🔗 Youtube
We seldom get opportunities to share our deeper thoughts and emotions with each other because societal norms discourage these informal practices, favoring formal discourse over emotional expression. Most importantly, without meaningful communication with others, we seem to lose our ability to recognize our own emotional state. Relato is a GenAI game designed to restore our capacity for self-disclosure through interaction and relationship-building with other agentic individuals in the game world. Players have opportunities to freely interact with these “individuals”—GenAI-powered NPCs inhabiting the same world. The responses and social network development provide a semi-formal channel for sharing emotional aspects of our lives, all facilitated by GenAI.

content: Beyond dance, I explore traditional and digital artistic expressions, including Guzheng, painting, and LEGO-based creative problem-solving. These interdisciplinary interests shape my approach to performance studies, allowing me to investigate the intersection of technology, embodiment, and artistic collaboration.
